name: agent-desktop
title: Agent Desktop
description: Control a connected cicy-desktop (Electron) client on this host. Exec shell, system info, live tool discovery, raw electronRPC via desktop_event over WebSocket.
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: Agent Desktop
zh-CN.description: 通过 WebSocket 调用已连接的 cicy-desktop (Electron) 客户端,支持 shell 执行、系统信息、实时工具发现、raw electronRPC 等。

tools.name: clients
tools.description: List connected cicy-desktop clients (client_id, platform, master)

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Round-trip liveness check against the connected client

tools.name: tools
tools.description: Query the client's live tool set via list_tools (--schema/--names/--tag); falls back to static reference

tools.name: exec
tools.description: Run a shell command on the desktop host

tools.name: exec-file
tools.description: Upload a local script and run it on the desktop (.sh/.py/.js runner picked by extension)

tools.name: sysinfo
tools.description: Full system info: platform, arch, os version, cpu, memory, disk, loadavg, network

tools.name: rpc
tools.description: Raw electronRPC call to any Electron-main tool with JSON args
